name: CONNER
description: CONNER is a comprehensive knowledge evaluation framework designed to systematically and automatically evaluate generated knowledge from large language models across six perspectives: Factuality, Relevance, Coherence, Informativeness, Helpfulness, and Validity.
reputation: A research-oriented framework that has seen limited standalone adoption, mostly cited as a method for evaluating generated knowledge quality rather than as a common leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Evaluates knowledge generation from LLMs on multiple quality dimensions beyond factuality; includes human annotations and evaluation code.
